title: Intel fiscal Q3 2026 results (after the close; call 2 p.m. PT) — the chip tape's last peer print before AMD's 11-03
source: NEWS: Intel's own press release 'Intel to Report Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results' (intc.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1782/), released 2026-10-06 4:01 pm EDT and fetched direct 2026-10-22: 'will report third-quarter financial results on Thursday, October 29, 2026, promptly after close of market', call 2:00 p.m. PDT. Filed estimate because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep; the date itself rests on the company's own announcement. The same day carries PCE, Q3 GDP and the AMZN print
notes: Discovered during the amd-fq3-2026-results-2026-11-03 pulse (2026-10-22). INTC fell 7% to about $86.64 on 2026-10-22 inside the eight-plus-session chip sell-off that has AMD -21% from its 10-06 high; it is the last semiconductor print before AMD's night, so its guide is a free read on CPU and foundry demand. Not an earnings-calendar entry.
